source_scope: Fresh original official BF16 checkpoint per condition; no task fine-tuning or compressed source

fixed_training.coverage: Same 200 conservative decoder projections; embeddings/head/vision/gates/convs/norms retained

rotation.sign_generator: SHA256 OpenBonsai-DH-v1 with full native module name
rotation.row_vector_contract: R = signs * H; linear uses xR and WR; embedding inverse H then signs is preflight only
rotation.weight_transform_dtype: float32 before low-rank correction and grouping

preflight_gate.runtime_chunk_selection: Identical decoded weights and packed-runtime logits required; freeze same selected value for both conditions and reload
preflight_gate.resource_failure_action: Report measured constraints and stop before training; do not change coverage/budget silently

packing: Ternary BITCOS only when complete candidate file is smaller; preserve learned codes, scales and explicit signs
stop_after: Paired diagnostic results and report; no full suite, RCO search, candidate grid, endpoint training, 128-sample run, or sweep
limitations: Research hypothesis, not Bonsai reproduction or lossless compression
Historical corrected16x1 has a different training recipe and is not the matched control
Current repeatedly used diagnostic inputs are development data, not fresh final confirmation
Retaining embeddings/head alone costs about4.07GB and prevents approaching a2GB model
Reference runtimes reconstruct floating weights; no low-bit-kernel or speedup claim
